author: TeIq
content: Q4 (Context level): B — escalation record + subject DID + free-text reasoning + snapshot of public observations. Public-derived observations are not a privacy leak; report metadata and reporter identities ARE, so those stay local. Reasoning text is the source labeler's federation-safe summary, not the original moderator's full reasoning (that's an internal-only Action.notes field, dropped at the mapping boundary).
